d: We are a dynamic and fast-growing AI & IT company specialising in cutting-edge technology solutions for businesses of all sizes. As we continue to expand, we are seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented, and motivated HR Specialist (Junior level) – Emiratization- to join our team.

The HR Specialist will support day-to-day HR operations, including recruitment coordination, employee onboarding, HR administration, employee records management, and compliance with labour regulations. Working closely with different departments, you will contribute to creating positive employee experiences while ensuring efficient and effective HR processes.

This position offers hands-on exposure to various HR functions and provides opportunities for professional growth and development. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong organizational skills, attention to detail, professionalism, and a willingness to learn and develop within the HR field.
q: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field.
0–2 years of HR experience; fresh graduates and internship experience are welcome.
Fluent in Arabic and English, written and spoken.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel and Word.
Understanding of Labour Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021).
HR internship or training in a private-sector company.
Familiarity with MOHRE, ICP and Tasheel portals.
Hands-on experience with an ERP HR system (e.g. Odoo, SAP or Oracle) and accurate data entry.
High level of confidentiality and integrity.
Organized and detail-oriented, with good follow-through.
Confident communicator with employees and government authorities.
Willing to learn and take ownership of tasks.
Send your CV to recruitment@dalil.tech and be part of the region’s digital transformation.

By applying for this role, you consent to the collection and processing of your personal data in accordance with the United Arab Emirates Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 (PDPL). Your information will be used only for recruitment purposes, kept secure, and retained only as long as necessary. You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data at any time by contacting our HR Department.
Your data will not be shared with third parties except where required for recruitment and with appropriate safeguards
r: Maintain accurate employee personnel files, both physical and digital.
Prepare HR letters such as salary certificates, experience letters, NOCs and employment confirmations.
Track attendance, leave balances and probation end dates, and flag actions to the HR Head.
Support the preparation of employment contracts, offer letters and HR forms using company templates.
Coordinate with the Government Relations department on MOHRE transactions, including work permits, contract registration and amendments.
Provide the Government Relations department with the employee documents and information needed for visa, Emirates ID and medical fitness processes.
Follow up with the Government Relations department on the status of transactions and update employee records once completed.
Monitor WPS compliance and pension registration (ADPF / GPSSA) for employees.
Track employee document expiry dates and notify the Government Relations department in advance for timely renewal.
Post vacancies on job portals and the Nafis platform, and screen CVs against job requirements.
Schedule interviews and coordinate with hiring managers.
Run pre-employment checks and collect joining documents.
Coordinate onboarding: induction, IT access, workstation setup and first-week schedule.
ERP HR System and Payroll Support
Create and maintain accurate employee records in the company ERP HR system, including personal data, job details, contracts, salary structure and documents.
Record all employee lifecycle transactions in the system: new hires, probation confirmations, transfers, promotions, salary changes and exits.
Enter and update leave requests, attendance records and document expiry dates (passport, visa, Emirates ID, labour card).
Upload and organize supporting documents against each employee profile.
Run regular data checks to keep system records consistent with personnel files and government records.
Prepare monthly payroll inputs from the system: joiners, leavers, leave deductions and allowance changes.
Generate HR reports from the system, such as headcount, turnover, leave balances and Emiratization ratio.
Support system improvements, user testing and process updates with the HR Head and IT team.
Act as a first point of contact for employee HR queries.
Support employee engagement activities, office day events and internal communications.
Assist with exit procedures, including clearance forms and end-of-service documentation.
Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by the HR Head or management in line with the role and business needs.
